title: That's why I brought it — it gets cold at night.
scene: 他多带一件衣服，解释考虑。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Did you bring an extra sweater with you?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: That's why I brought it — it gets cold at night.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: That was very thoughtful of you.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: So you don't have to come all the way back for me.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I really appreciate it, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Those sound like famous last words to me.

variations: "extra sweater" 换 "extra water"；"cold at night" 换 "thirsty on the way"。
